intent: Keep Broker App 1.0 aligned to the real SharpEdge + Robinhood Bridge surfaces.

resources.name: sharpedge://state/latest
resources.purpose: Latest market state and current SharpEdge signal context.

resources.name: sharpedge://execution/card/latest
resources.purpose: Latest execution card and trade-permission view for operator review.

resources.name: sharpedge://permission/latest
resources.purpose: Latest permission payload and supporting execution gate information.

resources.name: sharpedge://positions/latest
resources.purpose: Latest broker-facing positions snapshot available to SharpEdge workflows.

resources.name: sharpedge://handoff/latest
resources.purpose: Latest validated execution handoff artifact prepared for downstream delegation.

tools.name: sharpedge.discover_surface
tools.purpose: Return the current Argus-facing surface, authority map, and supported resources/tools.

tools.name: sharpedge.get_latest_state
tools.purpose: Return the latest SharpEdge state packet for operator review.

tools.name: sharpedge.get_execution_card
tools.purpose: Return the latest authoritative execution card without recalculating it in Argus.

tools.name: sharpedge.explain_permission
tools.purpose: Explain the latest permission card in plain language without changing the underlying score.

tools.name: sharpedge.prepare_broker_handoff
tools.purpose: Prepare a broker handoff from the authoritative SharpEdge signal and bridge policy.

tools.name: sharpedge.validate_handoff
tools.purpose: Validate route, risk, approval posture, and downstream payload contracts for a handoff.

governance_truths: Robinhood order-write style actions remain operator_confirm_required.
Argus should wrap real contracts instead of duplicating strategy or broker logic.
No direct broker action should be claimed from Broker App 1.0 without a validated handoff.
known_gaps: The current MCP layer is an in-process skeleton, not yet wired to a concrete external MCP SDK/runtime.
No unified Argus app shell yet bundles the existing cross-repo surfaces into one runtime.
External MCP transport plumbing still needs to be layered on top of the current server skeleton.
